description.value: Obanhmi is a BC-based Vietnamese street food chain specializing in bánh mì sandwiches, fresh rolls, and iced coffee, now operating 9 locations across Metro Vancouver. The menu ranges from French-influenced cold cuts to fully vegan and halal options, all built on house-made ingredients and freshly baked baguettes. Cyclists passing through the West Broadway corridor can place an online order for fast in-store pickup.
